mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1 exceeding 2% YoY signals strengthening economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with GDPC1 YoY growth > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low FEDFUNDS rate (< 0.5%) signals accommodative monetary policy, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window with FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in UNRATE below 4% signals a tightening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to expected rate hikes.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances with UNRATE < 4%.

mechanism_narrative: When INDPRO growth exceeds 1.5% MoM and HOUST is above its 6-month average, it signals supply chain resilience, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO MoM growth > 1.5% and HOUST > 6mo avg
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC for this joint condition remains below 0.05 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: RSAFS exceeding its 3-month average signals increased consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 55% of instances with RSAFS > 3mo avg.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in FEDFUNDS above 1.5% signals monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC for this condition remains below 0.02 over any 2.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When PAYEMS growth exceeds 200,000 jobs per month for two consecutive months, it signals labor market strength, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 50% of instances meeting the PAYEMS growth condition.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: GDPC1's YoY growth rate is positively correlated with S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, regardless of other conditions.
failure_condition: Walk-forward correlation coefficient between GDPC1 YoY growth and SPX 60d returns falls below 0.1 over any 3-year rolling window.
